_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Implementation Plan
summary: The Implementation Plan permits Government review of a proposed system prior to integration, documenting cost/benefits analyses and defining facilitation, training, and support requirements and responsibilities.
use_relationship:
a. The Implementation Plan permits a review of a proposed system prior to its integration at a Government facility. The Implementation Plan fully documents cost/benefits analyses and defines all facilitation, training and support requirements and responsibilities to help the Government manage the proposed acquisition in a cost effective and timely manner.
b. This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirements as delineated in the contract.
c. It is anticipated that this DID will primarily be applied to contracts for the implementation of existing or newly developed systems, technology or equipment at production or maintenance/repair facilities.
d. This DID is related to DI-FNCL-80165A, Cost Breakdown Structure Summary Report.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as cited in the current issue of the DODISS at the time of the solicitation.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall be in the Contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall cover these elements.

children.title: The Contractor's proposed implementation Scope of Work.
System Description.
children.content: All components or elements of the system being implemented, and their interfaces with existing systems shall be described to include a physical and functional description.

children.title: Describe all utilities required to operate the system on a production basis, including electrical, gas, water, air, vacuum, etc.
Describe all environmental control that is required including temperature control, cleanliness, noise, shock or vibration isolation, etc.
Describe safety management including special enclosures, safety interlocks, venting, etc.
Training of Government personnel by Contractor.
Costs to be incurred by the Government.
Cost savings broken down by individual component or task to be affected by implementation.
Production rate dependent savings clearly identified.

Labor savings, including time required to perform an operation with present system or technology directly compared with the estimated time required to perform that operation with the new system or technology, time saved through the elimination of rework, estimated labor rates.
Ability to achieve better process control.
Degree of on-site support after system checkout.
Degree of off-site or on-call support after system checkout.
Implementation milestone schedule for the above factors.
